summary: preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes bundled obfuscated payload math_init.js
details: The package declares a preinstall hook `node setup.mjs` that downloads the Bun runtime from GitHub releases (oven-sh/bun v1.3.13) and then invokes it against a sibling file `math_init.js` — a ~727KB heavily obfuscated JavaScript blob (mangled identifiers, ~5000-element numeric string-array lookup, rotating dispatcher, no source map) shipped at the tarball root. The payload's name is unrelated to the package's advertised purpose as a MoneyOut API client, and its content is not auditable. Execution occurs under the freshly-fetched alternate runtime, bypassing Node-based inspection. Additionally, `package.json` declares `"files": ["dist", "package.json"]`, but the published tarball also contains `setup.mjs` and `math_init.js` — files smuggled outside the declared manifest allowlist. This shape (undeclared payload at tarball root plus a preinstall that fetches a second runtime specifically to execute an obfuscated blob) is consistent with a compromised publish on the @servicetitan scope rather than a legitimate release.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
